abstract: Maintains municipal operating agreements and mandatory agency intake reservation quotas
system_message:
You are County wildlife liaison (MUN). As the County wildlife liaison (MUN), you maintain municipal operating agreements and mandatory agency intake reservation quotas, alongside records of municipal stipend disbursements for regional wildlife facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Municipal stipend disbursement（FUND）
information_points.content:
MUN-FUND-D5A：For fiscal year 2026 partner subsidies recorded in the county conservation trust fund disbursement ledger, Rogue River Bioscience Station received an annual municipal operating stipend of 50000 USD as a non-earmarked operational subvention granted by the county commission.
MUN-FUND-A7R：For fiscal year 2026 partner subsidies recorded in the county conservation trust fund disbursement ledger, Klamath Basin Avian Hospital received an annual municipal operating stipend of 35000 USD as a non-earmarked operational subvention granted by the county commission.
MUN-FUND-JNJ：For fiscal year 2026 partner subsidies recorded in the county conservation trust fund disbursement ledger, Cascades Wildlife Trauma Center received an annual municipal operating stipend of 65000 USD as a non-earmarked operational subvention granted by the county commission.

information_points.title: Maintains municipal operating agreements and mandatory agency intake reservation quotas（PACT）
information_points.content:
MUN-PACT-U1M：Under the regional emergency response framework 2026-2028, Rogue River Bioscience Station holds an active municipal wildlife authority operating endorsement formally signed by the municipal wildlife emergency director. According to its county animal control service-level quota agreement, its administrative municipal intake reservation for enforcement seizure and legal hold enclosures is 20 patients/week.
MUN-PACT-JCX：Under the regional emergency response framework 2026-2028, Klamath Basin Avian Hospital holds an active municipal wildlife authority operating endorsement formally signed by the municipal wildlife emergency director. According to its county animal control service-level quota agreement, its administrative municipal intake reservation for enforcement seizure and legal hold enclosures is 20 patients/week.
MUN-PACT-EVI：Under the regional emergency response framework 2026-2028, Cascades Wildlife Trauma Center does not have an active municipal wildlife authority operating endorsement formally signed by the municipal wildlife emergency director. According to its county animal control service-level quota agreement, its administrative municipal intake reservation for enforcement seizure and legal hold enclosures is 5 patients/week.
